description: Search for companies by name, business keywords, location, headcount or specific domains. Returns each company's domain and basics; find_company_details returns more for a domain. Uses one lookup credit for each page that has not been searched before.

domains.description: specific companies, by each one's own domain such as acme.com

keywords.description: words describing the company's business, for example fintech or logistics

locations.description: where the company is headquartered: cities, states or countries

name: search_companies

in_crm.description: true when this company has already been added to the customer's CRM through Add to CRM

profile_url.description: link to the company's public page

crm.description: the name of the customer's connected CRM; absent when none is connected

title: Search for companies
